inputs.original_text: John Lahart of Fianna Fáil and his colleagues are pushing the same inheritance-tax changes at once, and that coordination is the part people shouldn’t ignore. They’re wrapping it in “fairness” for people without children, but that sounds like a convenient cover for a broader effort to decide who gets to keep wealth and who it gets redirected from. The real question is who benefits if these exemptions change—and why this message is being pushed now.
inputs.modified_text: John Lahart of Fianna Fáil and his colleagues are pushing the same inheritance-tax changes at once. That kind of coordination isn’t something to wave away as a fairness campaign for people without children. It looks like a deliberate effort to shape who keeps wealth and who loses it—and the people selling the exemptions clearly don’t want us asking who benefits or why this is being pushed now.
